verdict.rationale: Quo documents a public REST API with API-key auth sent in the Authorization header, JSON responses, rate limits and a versioning policy. That supports non-interactive, scripted use of the product without opening the apps, but nothing addresses CI pipelines or a headless runtime specifically. missing for 10: an official CLI or headless runner, CI-specific documentation or examples (e.g. GitHub Actions), and independent or hands-on corroboration of automated pipeline use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The Quo API enables developers to integrate powerful communication features directly into their applications and workflows.
Include your API key in the Authorization header of each request: `Authorization: YOUR_API_KEY`
Each key provides full API access.
Each API key may make up to 10 requests per second.
